title: Cute Xmas Outfits: From the Office Party to Christmas Morning
seo_title: Cute Xmas Outfits: Six Looks for Every December Plan
meta_description: Cute xmas outfits for six December plans, from the office party and gift swap to Christmas morning. One easy formula each, so you can plan now.
excerpt: Six December plans, six outfit formulas: a blazer for the office party, sleeves for family dinner, black velvet for Christmas Eve and one real party dress.

hero.intro: These cute xmas outfits follow December the way it really runs, one plan at a time. The office party, the gift swap, family dinner, Christmas Eve, Christmas morning and one big night each get a simple formula. Plan them now, while there is still time to find the one piece your closet is missing.

sections.heading: Why plan cute xmas outfits in October
paragraphs: December fills up fast. Most of us own one good party outfit, wear it four times and then panic on the 22nd. A better plan is a small set of pieces that mix. Think one knit dress, one blazer, one skirt with some shine and one soft sweater. Those four, plus what you already own, cover every plan below.

Search cute clothes christmas and you mostly find reindeer and red sequins. That is fine for one party. For the rest of the month, think in textures instead: velvet, soft knits, satin and a little shine. Our pieces come in small batches and new ones go up every week. So if you see the size you want, it may not come back once it goes.

sections.heading: The office party: a blazer over a knit dress
paragraphs: Office parties sit between work and fun. You want to look like you tried, but not like you came straight from a club. The easy answer is a fine knit dress in a deep color, sheer tights and a low boot. Then add a blazer, wear it open and push the sleeves up once.

A korean fashion blazer often runs boxy, with a dropped shoulder and a longer body. That shape sits well over a slim knit, because the contrast does the work. Keep the blazer plain: black, camel, gray or cream. This is where elegant chic fashion lives, in two calm pieces that still look like a choice.
bullets: A fine knit dress, midi or just below the knee.
Sheer black tights and a low boot.
One piece of jewelry, close to the face.

sections.heading: The gift swap: cozy, but ready for photos
paragraphs: Gift swaps run long. People open, steal, trade and laugh for an hour, often on a sofa or the floor. So dress for sitting. Try a soft sweater, straight jeans or wide trousers, and clean sneakers or loafers. Pick a sweater with one detail, like a bow at the back or pearl buttons, so the photos still show an outfit.

Shopping for gifts for chinese gift exchange games, the kind where people can steal a wrapped present? Our Asian gift guide has ideas and a tip on setting the price range first. For your own outfit, keep cute clothes accessories small and playful. A velvet hair bow, a plaid scrunchie or a tiny bag on a chain all do the job. Trendy fashion jewelry works the same way. One pair of bold earrings beats five small pieces.

sections.heading: Family dinner: a dress with sleeves
paragraphs: Family dinner means a long table, a warm kitchen and a cold walk to the car. Sleeves help with all three. If you are on the shorter side, look at petite dresses long sleeve styles where the cuff lands at your wrist, not past your knuckles. A midi with a wrap or tie waist lets you sit, eat and still feel neat at dessert.

On petite dresses with sleeves, check the shoulder seam first. It should sit at the edge of your shoulder, so the sleeve falls straight. Then check the hem against your own height, since a midi on a model can read maxi on you. A cute xmas dress for dinner does not need red, either. Deep green, burgundy, navy and chocolate all look festive under warm light.

sections.heading: Christmas Eve: black velvet and one shine
paragraphs: Christmas Eve can go two ways. Some families keep it quiet, with a late service or a slow dinner. Others throw a party that runs past midnight. Black covers both. Black cute clothes sound like a contradiction, but they work. Think a black velvet top with a bow, a black knit with puff sleeves or a black skirt with a soft flare.

Then add shine with one piece only. That could be a satin skirt, a sequin cuff or stylish fashion jewellery like a long pendant. Want the look of affordable luxury clothes? Pick the fabric first. Velvet, satin and a fine knit look richer than any print. Keep the rest matte, and the one shiny piece gets all the attention.

sections.heading: Christmas morning, and matching done lightly
paragraphs: Christmas morning is about comfort, but someone will take photos. A soft knit set, or a long cardigan over a plain tee, looks good on camera and feels like pajamas. Choose cream, oatmeal or a soft red, and keep your hair simple. Warm socks finish it, and nobody needs to see shoes before noon.

Cute clothes for couples do not have to mean twin sweaters. Pick one shared color instead. If you wear a cream cardigan, your partner wears a cream scarf or a gray knit from their own closet. You look like a pair in photos, and nobody feels like a prop. We gathered more cute clothes for christmas and New Year in our winter guide.

sections.heading: The party dress night
paragraphs: Every December has one big night. It might be a friend's party, a work gala or dinner with dancing after. This is the night for a real dress. Searching petite dresses party? Start with the waist. A dress looks best when its waist sits at your own waist, not two inches below it.

Next, choose one statement and let it lead. A big bow, a sequin panel or a bold sleeve is plenty, and our statement pieces page shows how to build around one. Keep shoes and bag simple, because the dress already did the talking. If you plan to dance, pick a hem at the knee or just above it.
bullets: A small bag and shoes you can stand in for four hours.
A coat long enough to cover the hem.
Going long? Read our petite dress evening guide first.

sections.heading: Stay warm and keep the outfit
paragraphs: Korean fashion in winter has a smart trick: layer thin, not thick. Wear a fine turtleneck under a slip dress, sheer tights under opaque ones and a long coat over everything. You stay warm and the outfit you planned still shows. Our winter korean fashion page has more layers that work indoors and out.

Cute clothes for winter work best when every layer can come off and still look finished. Before you order, check the numbers. Pieces from Korea and Thailand often run smaller than US sizes. Measure a dress you love and compare it with the product page and our size guide. Returns are for store credit, within seven days of purchase, for items that are new and unused with tags. The returns policy has the rest.

faqs.q: What are cute xmas outfits for work that still feel festive?
faqs.a: Start with a knit dress, a boxy blazer and tights. Then add one festive detail: a velvet bow, a red lip or a pair of bold earrings. Skip anything that jingles. Office parties often start right after work, so pick pieces that pass at your desk at noon and still feel like a party at six.

faqs.q: What makes a cute xmas dress feel grown-up?
faqs.a: Fabric and color do most of it. Velvet, satin and fine knits in deep green, burgundy, navy or black look festive without a print. Keep to one detail, like a bow or a puff sleeve. If the dress already shines, keep everything else matte. Save the reindeer for the party that asks for it.

faqs.q: Do you sell matching outfits for couples?
faqs.a: No. We sell womenswear only, so there are no matching men's pieces. You can still match by color. Choose one shade from your outfit and ask your partner to wear it in a scarf, a knit or a shirt they already own. It looks planned in photos, and nobody has to wear a costume.

faqs.q: Will my order reach me before Christmas?
faqs.a: We cannot promise a delivery date on this page. Read our shipping policy before you order, and plan early. That is why this guide goes up in October. You get time to try pieces on at home, check the fit and still have a backup plan in your closet.

faqs.q: How do I dress petite for a holiday party?
faqs.a: Watch three lines: the shoulder seam, the waist and the hem. The seam should sit at the edge of your shoulder and the waist at your natural waist. The hem goes where you like it on your own legs. Measure a dress that fits you well, then compare it with the flat measurements on each product.
